question: Is there any correlation between governance quality and digital readiness score of South Asia?
query: SELECT   correlation FROM (   SELECT     CASE       WHEN country_code IN ('AFG', 'CHN', 'IND', 'PAK', 'OMA', 'SRI', 'BAN', 'NEP', 'BLR', 'MDD', 'NGA', 'KHM', 'MYS', 'LKA', 'PNG', 'FJI', 'ARM', 'AZR', 'GEO', 'PAK', 'TJK', 'UZB', 'KAZ', 'CMR', 'GMB', 'COD', 'GHA', 'TZA', 'EGY', 'KEN', 'CGD', 'NGA', 'CIV', 'SEN', 'BUR', 'MLI', 'MAW', 'SOM', 'GAB', 'BWA', 'BOT', 'MAD', 'MRT', 'MAU', 'COM', 'TCD', 'LBN', 'SYR', 'IRQ', 'YEM', 'JOR', 'UAE', 'SAU', 'KWR', 'CHN', 'JPN', 'AUS', 'NZL', 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR', 'FRA', 'DEU', 'ITA', 'ESP', 'POR', 'BEL', 'NLD', 'SWE', 'FIN', 'NOR', 'GRE', 'ROU', 'POL', 'CZE', 'HUN', 'PRT', 'SVK', 'BLR', 'RUS', 'UKR', 'MDA', 'BIH', 'SER', 'ALB', 'MKD', 'BUL', 'EST', 'Lat', 'Lith', 'SAD', 'Iceland', 'Ireland', 'CYP', 'Lux', 'Malta', 'SUI', 'Lie')       THEN 1       ELSE 0     END AS is_south_asia,     governance_quality_index,     digital_readiness_score   FROM global_development_indicators ) AS subquery WHERE   is_south_asia = 1;
